tools.name: search_ads
tools.description: Search stored NewsBreak/Rumble ads. Results contain at most 12 ads. sort=newest (default) orders by last observation; sort=longest_running orders by recorded observation span in whole days. minDays=7|30|90 keeps ads observed over at least that span. minSightings=2|5|10|25|50|100 requires at least th

tools.name: get_ad_evidence
tools.description: Read one captured ad, its recorded category provenance, text evidence, and device context. Does not fetch advertisers or generate previews.

tools.name: get_funnel
tools.description: Read only the recorded destination path. Unresolved, failed and unvisited steps remain explicit; this tool does not navigate or recover hidden pages.

tools.name: compare_ads
tools.description: Return recorded evidence for two to four distinct ads for comparison. It does not infer competitor spend or performance.

tools.name: research_groups
tools.description: Research advertisers or destination domains on one platform (newsbreak, rumble or youtube). kind=advertiser groups by the recorded advertiser label; kind=destination groups by the declared or stored landing domain. Without group, returns at most 24 groups with record counts and first/last observatio

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read the stored timed transcript of one Rumble video ad, 100 segments per page with start/end milliseconds. state shows when no transcript is ready; nothing is transcribed on request. Follow nextSegmentOffset for later segments.

tools.name: list_saved_ads
tools.description: List the caller's own saved ads, newest first, 12 per page, with the caller's collections. collectionId limits the page to one owned collection. Each item has the saved note and an ad summary, or ad_status=unavailable when the ad is no longer in the library. Follow nextOffset.

tools.name: save_ad
tools.description: Save one library ad to the caller's saved ads; optionally add it to one owned collection (collectionId from list_saved_ads) and set its note. Saving again is safe. A note replaces the existing note only when given. Use only when the user asks to save.
